authorization: User withdrew ten-run plan and requested direct tracking/synchronization waveforms in firmware. Prepare one manual ordinary/S3R2 pair only, not ten repetitions.
stage: Waveform and recording preview, not a confirmatory efficacy comparison
controlSource: Exact round48 frozen ordinary65511 and originalS3R266312 control sources. Only build/schema identity and read-only UART-view formatting change.

channels.I53: 1000*((I5+I6)/2-I3), signed mean-position tracking error in mm
channels.I54: 1000*(I5-I6), signed left-minus-right synchronization error in mm
channels.replaced: Duplicated raw generalized coordinates, recoverable from unchanged I5/I6
channels.I5_I6: Left/right encoder-derived positions in metres, unchanged

implementation: Compute only in low-priority vofa_task after the existing snapshot and before DMA buffer serialization. No new motor_task computation. The other105 channel mappings are preserved, with expected identity-value changes at I63(build) and active I93(schema). Event/fault payloads and107-channel432-byteJustFloat frame remain unchanged.
physicalScope: At most one manually flashed/recorded run per method: empty0g,2mm out/back,1200/1200counts,HW6. All original guards/trajectory/network initialization unchanged. No assistant hardware action, no automatic repeats.
safety: Drive power off for flashing. Onsite operator with emergency stop, secured empty platform and clear travel. Archived boot-start behavior remains; enable VOFA reception before deliberate fresh power-on/reset. No unattended motion. On abnormal behavior stop safely and preserve history.
record: Record all107 channels, display only I53/I54 for uncluttered error waveforms. Clear old history before each fresh run, never reset/reflash within one CSV. Success: phase6,fault0,correct event magic andI89=4,then>=10seconds andI0>=100seconds before export. Fault: stop safely and preserve same history and fault tail. No rerun solely for a favorable result.
interpretation: I53/I54 are sampled signed instantaneous errors at40ms, not1ms trace, tracking RMSE or syncRMS. Plot near zero and compare both signs; visual judgement does not establish superiority. Primary calculation remains based on original I3/I5/I6 over phases2..5 with drive permit. Earlier ten-run plan is suspended, not deleted.
release: Host checks and ARM build required. First manual preview checks on-board timing/communication; no previous1ms WCET guarantee inferred from a successful compile.
